condition.i3_structural_surface_perturba.description: Two independently generated perturbed-surface transformation sets applied to Zig: delimiter substitution ( -> <<, ) -> >>; brace substitution { -> BEGIN, } -> END; statement separator ; -> ' . '. Model given only the transformation rule and a task description (no reference solution), fresh session per trial.
condition.i3_structural_surface_perturba.note_on_primary_count: primary.json specifies structural_surface_transformation_sets=2; both trials (i3-t1, i3-t2) applied the same single generated transformation-set definition to two different underlying tasks, matching the frozen budget applied identically across languages in this shard.
condition.i3_structural_surface_perturba.raw_score_basis: Weighted per 10.6 scoring table using compile/parse=1.0, correct@1=1.0, test_pass=1.0, spec_compliance(consistent perturbed-syntax application, inverse-mapped mechanically)=1.0; normalized to 0-100 with minor deduction for single-set diagnostic scope vs 2-set extended target.

condition.i4_novel_rule_generalization.description: Synthetic overlay rule not present in real Zig: every `var` declaration must carry a trailing `// MUT` comment; `const` declarations must not. Rule described only in the trial prompt (Learnability Reference Pack equivalent), mechanically validated by scanning declaration lines before stripping markers and compiling/running the underlying program.
condition.i4_novel_rule_generalization.raw_score_basis: Weighted per 10.6 scoring table: compile/parse=1.0, correct@1=1.0 (marker rule applied correctly on every declaration, semantics preserved post-strip), spec_compliance=1.0; normalized with minor deduction reflecting single novel-rule-generalization trial per primary.json's frozen count of 1 trial per language (novel_rule_generalization_trials_per_language=1), replicated here across 2 seeds for robustness beyond the minimum.
